notes: This portable C++ TCK case publishes two adapter-selected ordinary interaction classes, withdraws both through the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API, and queries the result through the IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. The provider library, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and class names remain adapter-supplied. No vendor hooks or DDM region APIs are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unpublishInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass) = 0
